findings.text: Servex/agents/Agents.js:419-421 (diff lines 419-421) — when no pool slot is ready, the minion is spawned anyway in the main tree ("writing in <cwd>"). The brief says plainly "main stays refused for minions", and that fallback lets the exact incident that started this task happen again whenever the pool is empty or still preparing. Refuse the spawn instead: throw a clear error ("no worktree ready — spawn a task-mastermind, or retry"). The test at spawn-worktree.test.mjs:511 then checks for the refusal instead of the fallback.

Servex/Pool.js:379 `take_sync` — its comment calls the git call "BOUNDED", but `execFileSync("git", … merge --ff-only)` has no `timeout`, and it blocks the whole Servex event loop while it runs. Add `timeout: 15000`, as the other sync git calls should have.

Server/owner-check.mjs:343-345 — if an older `owner-check.md` is already in the folder (from a second landing or a run by hand) and the new reviewer fails to write one, the script reads the old table back and logs it as fresh. Delete the file before `spawn_agent`.

Server/owner-check.mjs:353 — the log line counts `items.length`, but done/partly/missing are counted from the reviewer's table rows. If the reviewer merges or skips rows, "N items" won't add up to D+P+M; count from `table.length`, or log the mismatch.

Server/owner-check.mjs:244-249 — the extra "one item per `##` heading" tier is a deliberate departure from the brief's three tiers. It is explained in the doc and in the code, and it fits the real owner-words.md files, so I accept it. But a 6-heading file came back as 8 items in the proof (Server/doc/on-landing.md:88), because `###` sub-headings count as items too. Say so in the doc, or split on `##` only.

The check that the brief asked for in "Proof" (`git diff --stat` of the task's merge) only works when the landing outcome contains the text "merge <sha>" (owner-check.mjs:272). Otherwise the reviewer gets no diff at all. That is acceptable as best-effort, but the doc should say a landing outcome without "merge <sha>" gets no diff.
